subject: Decision velocity: post-demo recap, stakeholder asks & next steps
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <skhan@finova.com>, Tom Ellis <tellis@finova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Decision velocity: post-demo recap, stakeholder asks & next steps

Hi Samira / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our end and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the pilot decision: 

What we demonstrated (short):
- Redwood inference runtime: 95th percentile latency reduction vs. current baseline on your LLMs, live KV caching demo, and autoscaling simulation.
- Integration patterns: VPC-private deployment + KMS key flow for model payloads.
- Cost controls: batching/caching knobs and Optimize suggestions that drove 20–30% estimated token-cost savings in our scenario.

Key decision criteria you surfaced:
1) Measurable latency improvements for end-user workflows (esp. claim processing path)
2) Clear security evidence (SOC2, retention/audit) and KMS integration confirmation
3) Procurement timeframe and commercial flexibility for a 6–12 month pilot

As discussed, can you confirm the internal owners for each bucket so we can tailor artifacts:
- Economic buyer (budget sign-off) — who should we include?
- Security reviewer (SOC2 / architecture review) — contact name/email
- Procurement / vendor onboarding team — contact or generic mailbox

Immediate next steps we propose (feel free to modify):
1) We’ll share a one-page ROI snapshot tailored to the claim-processing volume you mentioned (by EOD tomorrow).
2) Ben will prepare a short champion playbook (talk tracks + ask templates) for Tom as an internal sponsor.
3) Security: we’ll post a SOC2 snapshot and a short KMS integration note to the Drive link below.
4) Schedule a 30-min procurement + security sync next week to unblock legal/contract questions.

Attachments: deck_v2.pdf (PDF, 2.3MB) — updated with the production SLA examples and perf charts.
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b-example-deal-notes

Thanks again —
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0118

From: Samira Khan <skhan@finova.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tellis@finova.com>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@finova.com>, procure@finova.com
Date: 2028-06-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Decision velocity: post-demo recap, stakeholder asks & next steps

Irene — great demo, thanks. Quick answers so you can route materials: 

- Economic buyer: Tom Ellis (CFO) — tom.ellis@finova.com — he wants a succinct ROI that shows run-rate impact over 12 months.
- Security reviewer: Lydia Park (Senior InfoSec Engineer) — lydia.park@finova.com — she will ask the usual SOC2 + encryption / dataflow diagrams.
- Procurement: procure@finova.com (vendor onboarding team) — cc’d.

Lydia: I’m looping you so you see what we saw. Two asks from my side:
1) Please include a sample SLA & incident escalation ladder (Tom wants to understand uptime guarantees and SRE support window).
2) An ROI page is perfect — include token-cost delta and expected latency gains on our 85th/95th pctiles.

We’re targeting an internal approval decision in the week of July 8. Can you get the ROI + security snapshot by June 22 so I can share with Tom & Procurement?

Thanks —
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Data Science, Finova
skhan@finova.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <skhan@finova.com>, Tom Ellis <tellis@finova.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Decision velocity: post-demo recap, stakeholder asks & next steps

Copying internal owners to map out execution items. Summary & owner matrix below — will put deliverables in the Drive folder.

Owners / short plan: 
- Economic buyer (Tom) — we provide 1-pg ROI + 2-slide exec summary (OWNER: Ben) — due 2028-06-22 5pm PT.
- Security (Lydia) — publish SOC2 snapshot + KMS/dataflow notes (OWNER: Marissa) — request to Security team for short Q&A doc.
- Procurement (procure@finova.com) — legal template + standard SOW + sample SLA (OWNER: Legal ops, cc Marissa) — ask legal to start review.

Champion kit for Tom (Ben):
- One-pager: value statements + 3 talk tracks tailored to CFO (cost, predictable ops, marketplace risk reduction).
- Email template Tom can forward to his procurement lead and CFO peers.
- Quick rebut deck: answers to common procurement/legal redlines.

Links & refs: 
- Draft ROI template: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b-example-deal-notes
- Example SLA language: (internal) https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/sla-templates

Irene / Marissa: I’ll share the champion_script.docx and the ROI snapshot shortly. Marissa — can you pull the SOC2 extract and an architecture sketch (KMS flow) so Lydia can triage?

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0133

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tellis@finova.com>, Samira Khan <skhan@finova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@finova.com>, procure@finova.com
Date: 2028-06-22T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Champion primer + ROI snapshot (attached)

Tom / Samira — attaching the champion primer and the 1-pg ROI we discussed. Quick notes: 
- ROI assumptions are conservative and use your volume numbers from today’s demo.
- SLA excerpt included (page 2) with uptime targets + escalation contacts.

Attachments: champion_script.docx (DOCX, 45KB); ROI_onepager.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Tom — below is a short talk track you can use when briefing the CFO/Procurement: 

"We ran Redwood against our pre-prod model and saw a 25% reduction in tail latency and a 22% reduction in projected token spend with caching enabled. For a 6-month pilot the expected net savings (after pilot fees) are X — and Redwood offers a private VPC deployment and KMS integration that meets our compliance baseline."

If helpful I can jump on a 20-min prep call with you before you speak to Procurement.

Best —
Irene
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Ellis <tellis@finova.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <skhan@finova.com>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@finova.com>, procure@finova.com
Date: 2028-06-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Champion primer + ROI snapshot (attached)

Thanks Irene — I’ll take the primer to our exec meeting on Friday. A couple quick asks from my side before I present: 
1) Can you provide a single-slide summary showing expected cost delta vs our current provider and expected ops headcount impact?
2) Confirm whether Redwood offers a 24x7 SRE escalation add-on and the expected response SLA.

If we get those two items today, I’ll route to Procurement next week and request the procurement kickoff meeting for July 3.

Tom Ellis
CFO, Finova
